caption: I moved out for the job and my salary moved with me, just not very far. What's normal for a first posting?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R16 900
p/m salary
Living in Kokstad
slides.body:
Male, 23
Single, no kids
Job: SAPS constable, first posting
Net salary: R16 900 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Room in a shared house with two other constables
slides.body: We rotate who does the grocery run based on whoever's off dayshift that week.

slides.title: Personal loan
slides.includes: Kit, boots and travel costs from training college
slides.body: Nobody told me the uniform allowance comes later than the uniform does.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.body: Whoever's on nightshift eats the most. It's usually me.

slides.title: Fuel & transport
slides.includes: My own car, since the station vehicles are for the job, not for me
slides.body: The station is 40km from anywhere I'd actually want to be off duty.

slides.title: Takeaways & data
slides.includes: Garage food after nightshift, data for the group chat home
slides.body: I tell myself it's cheaper than cooking at 6am. I've never actually checked.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Insurance, funeral policy, family support, phone contract, gym
slides.body: The family support line is new since I started earning. Nobody asked me to add it.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R16 900. First posting pay. It gets better with rank, everyone keeps telling me.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded three months of statements to Beyond Horizon to see if the training loan was actually the problem. It wasn't — takeaways were.

No bank login needed.
